pages.title: Multiple Conditions
pages.content: Use `elif` (else if) to check additional conditions, and `else` to handle everything that didn't match. Only the first matching block runs.

pages.title: Quick Check
pages.question: What keyword handles the 'otherwise' case?
pages.explanation: The else block runs when no if or elif condition was True.
